starting-the-quest-talking-to-prince-itz.player: Hey, Itzla. How are things going?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-prince-itz.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
starting-the-quest-talking-to-prince-itz.text: Father should make a full recovery, though given that his would-be killers are still out there, that's not anywhere near as much comfort as it should be.
If the player does not meet the quest requirements:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I've sent word to mother about what happened here, but I've not heard back yet. Once I have, we can start planning our next move.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start The Heart of Darkness quest.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-prince-itz.text: If the player meets the quest requirements:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I've sent word to mother about what happened here, but I've not heard back yet. However, in the meantime, I've devised a little plan for how we might go about dealing with our cultist problem.

steps.prompt: Start The Heart of Darkness quest?

steps.player: What is it?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: We're going to go... undercover!

steps.player: Undercover? What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: The Twilight Emissaries of course! If they are the ones responsible for what is now two attempts on my father's life, their deaths will be swift and brutal.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: However, given we're somewhat civilised people, we can't exactly start executing cultists without definitive proof. How do we get that? By joining up of course!

steps.player: You want us to join the cult?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Exactly! Quite a clever plan, if I do say so myself.

steps.player: Right...

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Prepare for the arrival of Queen Zyanyi Arkan!

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Ah... This should be fun.

steps.player: I'd love to hear it, but I have some things I need to do first.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Very well. I'll be here when you're ready.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: A cutscene begins in which Queen Zyani Arkan meets with Prince Itzla Arkan.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Mother.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: As I stand here, the healers toil to save the life of the Teokan of Ralos.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Why?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: He wished to return to the Teomat. I advised against it, but...

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: So you would blame him?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Not exactly...

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Then take responsibility. You were charged with rooting out those who would plot against us. You failed. Why?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: With respect, progress has been made. We believe the Twilight Emissaries to be responsible, but we need to obtain proof before we can act.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: How?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: We will infiltrate the cult and gather any information we can. Once we have confirmed their guilt, they will be eradicated.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: We?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: This is a task of upmost importance. I intend to lead the infiltration myself.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: So you would chase glory like it is gold to be hoarded? You are the heir to Varlamore. It is not your place.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: In Varlamore we lead from the front!

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: You do not lead at all, boy! You command the Knights of Varlamore. Use them!

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: I cannot trust them. We have been infiltrated and our enemies now sit beside us.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: You speak of Metzli?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: It could be more than just her. One of my knights was implicated, but another may have incriminated him.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Who?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: There have been suspicions directed at Furia and Ennius.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Then all the more reason that you exclude yourself. Determine who you can trust and send them on this mission of yours.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: And if there is no one I can trust?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Then you have failed as a leader.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Mother...

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Now go. You have work to do. I don't expect you to fail me again.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Yes, my Queen. May the sun light your way.
The cutscene ends and Prince Itzla Arkan returns to The Teomat.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: It would seem I won't be able to join you on this mission, iknami. Still, I have no doubt you will be successful all the same.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.player: What do I need to do?

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Head to the pub in Quetzacalli Gorge and ask to rent the basement room. I have a contact who will meet you there.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: One of the only people left that I can trust. They'll fill you in on the details of how you'll infiltrate the Emissaries. Good luck, [player name]. May the sun light your way.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Nilsal, [player name]. You should head on over to the pub in Quetzacalli Gorge. Remember, you'll need to rent the basement room. My contact will meet you there.

meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
meeting-with-queen-zyani-arkan-to-begin-.text: Good luck.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-talking-to-.speaker: Bartender
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-talking-to-.text: Welcome to the Windbreaker. We've got the best drinks around.

options.text: I'd like to rent the basement room.

steps.player: I'd like to rent the basement room.

steps.text: If the player is asking about the basement room for the first time:

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: We don't have a basement room... but I do have a nice big one here on the ground floor that's available. It's 30 coins for the night.
If the player is asking about the basement room again:

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: Like I said, we don't have a basement room. However, I do have a nice big one here on the ground floor that's available. It's 30 coins for the night.
If the player does not have enough money:

steps.player: I don't have that much on me right now.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: Well you know where we are if that changes.

steps.player: I'll take it.

steps.text: You give 30 coins to the bartender.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: Thank you very much. The room is all yours. Enjoy!

steps.player: That's too much.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: Well you know where we are if you change your mind.

options.text: What's with those big gates out there?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: Guess I may as well have a little rest while waiting for this contact.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: You lie down on the bed and quickly fall asleep.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Rise and shine!

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: Itzla? Is that you? What are you doing here?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Isn't it obvious? I'm your contact!

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Look, I fully appreciate what my mother said. I have carefully considered her instructions, but in this one very specific situation, I have come to the conclusion that they must be disregarded.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: But you're the heir to the throne of Varlamore... What if someone recognises you?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Well that's why I've covered my face of course. Simple!

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: This seems like a bad idea...

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: You may well be right, iknami, but that is a bridge we will cross, and then quite possibly burn, when we get to it.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: I can see you're still not convinced, so let me be frank. I wasn't lying when I spoke to mother. The number of people we can trust is concerningly low.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Metzli, one of the most important people in the entire kingdom, has seemingly betrayed us. If your suspicions are right, Furia and Ennius are guilty as well. For all we know, there could be even more.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: At this point, the fewer people who know about our mission, the better.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: The irony is, my friend, that as an outsider, you're actually far more trustworthy than any Varlamorian now. You almost certainly can't be part of this conspiracy.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: Okay, I'm still not sure if I like this plan, but I see your point. What's our next move?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: We need to infiltrate the Twilight Emissaries and confirm their guilt. I've done some digging, and rumour has it that they're on a bit of a recruitment spree at the moment. That's our way in.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: The cult makes their home in the Twilight Temple, east of here. I suspect they won't take kindly to us just walking in, but the local shopkeeper here might be able to help us out.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: He's been engaging in many a charitable undertaking recently. Food for the poor, potions for the sick, that sort of thing. You'd be mistaken for thinking him to actually be a reasonable person.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Sadly not in this case. The Emissaries accept members from all walks of life, but the vast majority of their recruits are those from more unfortunate backgrounds.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: Ah I see. They have people like this shopkeeper using charity to attract people to their cause.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Exactly. It is... unfortunate. The War of Betrayal was over a lifetime ago, but many still feel the impacts, especially in this part of the kingdom.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: I'd like to think we have made great improvements over the years, but this is a clear reminder that far more needs to be done.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Anyway, it's not something to dwell on now. Let us get back to the more pressing matter of joining a dangerous cult.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: Right. So this shopkeeper... If I go to him and pose as a potential recruit, your hope is that he'll contact the Emissaries?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Exactly! Return to me here once you've hopefully been successful and we can discuss the next steps.

options.text: Alright, I'll go and speak with him.
The Queen didn't seem very happy with you.

steps.player: The Queen didn't seem very happy with you.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: That's parents for you. Do as I say, but not as I do. She was never afraid to get her own hands dirty. Did you know that before she was even my age, she became a champion in the Colosseum?

steps.player: You think she sees herself in you? If so, maybe she doesn't want you to make the mistakes that she once did?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I suspect you are right, but I would prefer to learn from my own mistakes. Every ruler must forge their own path. The people will never follow a leader who cannot stand alone.

steps.player: I suppose that makes sense, but I'm not sure how I feel about you learning from your mistakes while we infiltrate a dangerous cult together.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Fear not, iknami. I am confident that you will probably survive this mission.

steps.player: That's good, I think...

options.text: Do you really think Metzli, Furia and Ennius are traitors?

steps.player: Do you really think Metzli, Furia and Ennius are traitors?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Metzli has always been an odd one. Everyone was always quick to dismiss it as just a little side effect of spending a lot of time with dead people. Now I wonder if she used that to her advantage.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: No one cared to pay close attention to her. No one wanted to spend much time around her. She probably got away with all sorts of things without anyone even noticing.

steps.player: But a traitor?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: The evidence seems to suggest so. Why else would she have disappeared after the attack?

steps.player: Maybe they captured her?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Maybe, but surely someone would have noticed. People generally don't go quietly when captured.

steps.player: What about Furia and Ennius?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well their family has of course produced traitors before, but they've never seemed to have much love for old Imafore.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: By the end of the war, I think he'd ended up killing more of his own family members than he left alive. Amazing what paranoia will do to a man.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Still, even if they never cared for him, his blood still runs in their veins, and they've never been short on ambition themselves.

steps.player: If they are guilty... what will you do to them?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: The same thing we do to all traitors in Varlamore.

options.text: What happens if they try to attack Servius again?

steps.player: What happens if they try to attack Servius again?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: He's in the capital now, where I wanted him to be from the start. He should be much safer there.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Still, safer is not safe, especially if we do have traitors in our midst. At any moment we risk someone showing some basic competence and actually managing to kill him properly.

steps.player: So you don't consider the enemy to be competent?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: All I'm saying is that if I'd have been the one trying to assassinate my father, I'd probably have done a half- decent job.

steps.player: But if the enemy isn't a threat, why are you here?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: What do you mean, iknami?

steps.player: If this isn't an enemy to be taken seriously, why do you feel you yourself need to be the one to deal with them? If they're incompetent, shouldn't anyone be able to handle them?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: So you challenge me, iknami? I'm wounded. However, as I said before, I do not feel we can trust many people while we have potential traitors around us.

steps.player: But if they've managed to position some of their members in very important roles, surely they can't be completely incompetent?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: We do not need to do this dance, [player name]. I understand that where you come from, there is a certain art to holding a conversation. We do not bother with that here. You may be direct.

steps.player: I guess I just still don't know you that well. If we're about to infiltrate this cult together, I'd like to understand why you think it's important you do this yourself.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I see. I understand your doubts, my friend. I suppose I have a few reasons for wanting to be here.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: First, I do truly believe this mission has the highest chance of success if fewer people know about it. While I am not convinced on the competence of our foe, I still do not intend to underestimate them.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Second, I suppose I feel a certain level of responsibility. My father was attacked on my watch. When someone falters, it is their duty to fix it, especially when they hold a position like mine.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: After all, a leader who sits by and lets others deal with his mistakes is not someone to have faith in.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Finally, Servius is my father. Our relationship is not a simple one, but he is my father all the same. I would see to it personally that his attackers face justice.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I hope that satisfies you, iknami.

steps.player: It does. Thank you, Itzla.

options.text: I'd better go and speak to this shopkeeper.

steps.player: I'd better go and speak to this shopkeeper.

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.player: Itzla? Is that you? What are you doing here?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Nilsal, [player name]. Any luck with that shopkeeper?

visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
visiting-the-windbreaker-bar-resting-in-.text: Keep at it. He's our only way of infiltrating the Emissaries.

options.text: The Queen didn't seem very happy with you.
Do you really think Metzli, Furia and Ennius are traitors?
What happens if they try to attack Servius again?
Alright, I'll go and speak with him.

talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.speaker: Shopkeeper
talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.text: Hello there. Looking for some supplies?

options.text: I hear you can offer help to those in need.

steps.player: I hear you can offer help to those in need.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Well I'm always happy to help those less fortunate than I, but you don't really look like you need that sort of thing.

steps.player: I'm not sure if I should be insulted by that, or flattered... But anyway, you misunderstand. I'm not looking for help myself. Instead I was hoping to do some helping alongside you.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Thank you for the offer, but I'm not really looking for help right now.

steps.player: Are you sure? I do also quite like death.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: What are you on about?

steps.player: You know, end of the world, holy fire, final dawns, that sort of thing.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Are you a fool? Keep your voice down!

steps.player: Look, I'm not here to cause problems. I just want to help.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: You want to join the Emissaries?

steps.player: And a friend as well.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: You know there are tests you'd need to pass, right? Not everyone can be considered worthy.

steps.player: Fine by me. I love tests!

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: There is a penalty for failing them.

steps.player: Okay, not quite as fun, but I'm still up for it.

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Well... if you're sure, fetch your friend and then head east to the Twilight Temple. I will send word for them to expect you both.

steps.player: Lovely! Thanks!

talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.speaker: Shopkeeper
talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.text: Hello there. Looking for some supplies?

steps.player: About the Emissaries...

steps.speaker: Shopkeeper
steps.text: I already told you to keep your voice down! Fetch your friend and then head east to the Twilight Temple. I will send word for them to expect you both.

steps.player: Great! Thanks!

talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.text: Nilsal, [player name]. Any luck with that shopkeeper?

talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.player: He's going to reach out to the Emissaries and let them know to expect us at their temple.

talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.text: Kuani! Let us not waste any time then. I will meet you at the Twilight Temple. You'll find it east of here, on the other side of the Proudspire.

talking-to-the-quetzacalli-gorge-shopkee.player: Sounds good. I'll see you there shortly.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.player: Okay... So what happens now that we're here?

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.text: It seems this tower is where the Emissaries evaluate possible new members. If we're to get anywhere here, we're going to need to pass whatever tests they might have for us.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.text: Apparently, someone called Forebearer Janus will call upon us when it's our turn to be tested. In the meantime, we may as well mingle with these other potential recruits.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.player: You think they might know something of note?

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan.text: Unlikely, but it would be interesting to know why they woke up one day and decided their calling in life was to join a cult.

options.text: This whole place is very fancy.

steps.player: This whole place is very fancy.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Yes, I must admit the Emissaries have a more elaborate setup than expected. They've never been this organised before, nor have their numbers been so great. Something must have changed.

steps.player: Did they build everything here themselves?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Thankfully they are not quite that well put together. The temple here was built not long before the War of Betrayal. It is said that Imafore wanted somewhere dedicated to Ranul that would rival the Teomat.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'm guessing he was too foolish to realise that the Teomat is equally dedicated to both Ralos and Ranul.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Anyway, the temple was considered an affront to both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul. After Imafore died, most people were more than happy to see it abandoned.

steps.player: And the Emissaries eventually moved in?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Yes, but only very recently.

steps.player: Interesting... I wonder what the cause was.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: If all goes well, we will hopefully soon find out.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: We still haven't been called upon yet. We may as well mingle with these other potential recruits while we wait.

steps.player: Alright, I'll get mingling.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: Greetings, iknami. It's good to see so many who are willing to contribute to the Final Dawn. The word of the Augur has changed everything. The time to act is now.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Nova
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: You have not heard? She is the one who now leads the Emissaries. She has taken this once helpless collective and turned them into the ones who will guide us all to Mokhaiotl.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.player: How do you know all this? You're not even a member yet.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Nova
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: I was once. In my time of need, I turned to the Emissaries, but they were even more helpless than I was.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Nova
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: Now though, she has changed everything. Now it is my duty to rejoin their ranks so that we may bring about the Final Dawn.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.player: I see. Thanks for the information.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Caritta
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: Hello! You're not from around here, are you? It's exciting to see that even people from outside of Varlamore are looking to join the Emissaries!

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.player: Well after I heard about all the good work they were doing, I could hardly say no! What about you? What made you want to join them?

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Caritta
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: Well it's our duty of course! The Church of Ralos has become lost, but the Emissaries know the truth. Ximoua will not come to be unless we make it so!

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.player: So you're quite eager to see the end of the world then?

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.speaker: Caritta
talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.text: End? Ximoua is no end! It is the beginning! We will all come together as one and bring about a new world! I can't wait!

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.player: Well I'm glad to see you're so excited. Good luck with the tests.

talking-to-prince-itzla-arkan-talking-to.player: I'm sure it will be fine.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Like with Ximoua, the Final Dawn sees Ralos and Ranul come together, uniting all souls as one. In doing so they destroy this world and create a new one.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: After that, the two gods separate again, but the souls they united stay within them. The cycle then starts over once more.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan

steps.text: I wished to see my god in mortal form and be granted eternity in Mictl. In return for my service, the Emissaries promised me they could grant that wish.

steps.player: Who do you worship?

steps.speaker: Eleuia
steps.text: I am a humble servant of Ranul. It has always been my hope to stand before him and be judged as worthy.

options.text: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.player: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.text: If Eleuia is not the traitor:

steps.speaker: Eleuia
steps.text: The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared as he and Ralos guide us into forming a new world.
If Eleuia is the traitor:

steps.speaker: Eleuia
steps.text: The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared. He and Ralos will lead us into forming a new world before then guiding us to Mictl.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.prompt: Are you sure you wish to select [member's name] as the traitor?

steps.player: I choose [member's name]. This is your traitor.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Very well.
If the player chose an innocent member:
Forebearer Janus casts a spell at the member, gravely injuring them.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: I'm afraid you have made the wrong choice. Let's try this again...
The third trial is reset.
If the player chose the traitor:
Forebearer Janus casts a spell at the member, killing them.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Nicely done. [member's name] was indeed the traitor. You have both done well, but I wonder how well you will work together in the final trial...

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.text: Be sure to choose more carefully this time, recruit.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: [Innocent member]
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.text: Hey! No need for that. You found the failure among us already.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.text: Great work, [player name]. On to the final trial!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: Are you ready to start the next trial?

steps.player: I'm ready!

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Well done, recruits. Victory is within your reach, but one more trial awaits...

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Face your opponent.

steps.player: Wait...

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: Er...

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: An Emissary must be prepared to sacrifice anything and everything. Only through sacrifice will we deliver Twilight's Promise. Only through sacrifice will we achieve the Final Dawn.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: Well, you heard the man, [player name]. Shall we dance?

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.player: I'm not sure if you should be so...

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-f.text: Ready yourselves! May the best warrior win!

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: You might want to dodge this one!

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Reckon you can dodge this?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'd move if I were you!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-d.text: Prince Itzla blocks the special attack with a protection prayer.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-d.player: You're not allowed to do that!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: You and your companion will fit in nicely here. Let us head to the main chamber to discuss what happens next.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-a.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-a.text: You don't need to be going up there. You've already completed your trials.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Well that was fun!

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.player: You know you're not meant to be enjoying yourself, right?

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Don't be like that! Surely you must admit you enjoyed it a bit as well?

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.player: I suppose I liked the part where I beat you.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Right, moving swiftly on. Let's see what Forebearer Janus has to say to us.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Congratulations to you both on completing the trials. You will make fine Emissaries.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: Now the Augur herself will oversee your initiation. You may collect your new robes from that chest over there. Put them on and proceed into the temple.
If followed by Itzla:

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Congratulations on completing the trials. You will make fine Emissaries.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: If not followed by Itzla:

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Congratulations on completing the trials, [player name]. You will make a fine Emissary.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.text: We'd better change into those robes.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.text: Let's head over to the temple.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.speaker: Forebearer Janus
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-t.text: You should proceed to the temple. The Augur awaits.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: You search the chest and find some cultist robes for yourself and Itzla. Itzla puts his on.
You search the chest and find some cultist robes. However, you don't have enough room to take them.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-r.text: You search the chest and find some cultist robes.

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-s.text: You search the chest, but find nothing of interest

descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-a.speaker: Emissary Ascended
descending-into-the-tower-of-ascension-a.text: Hey! You don't have permission to go in there!

initiation.speaker: Forebearer Fides
initiation.text: Welcome, friends. You chosen few stand here because you have proven yourselves to be worthy. Here, you will not just find a home, you will find a family. Together, this family will bring about the Final Dawn.

initiation.speaker: Forebearer Fides
initiation.text: No doubt you are wondering how we will achieve our destiny. I call upon our glorious leader, the Augur, to explain our holy mission.
Augur Metzli walks onto the stage.

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: This morning, you were nothing more than ants, scrambling to find purpose amongst the dirt. Now though... now you have achieved ascension.

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: Once, I was just the same. Like so many of you, I started my life with nothing. I would wake each morning and pray that I would find enough food to last through the day.

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: All the while, those above me treated me worse than a common criminal. I was a villain to them! Why? Simply because they were born with privilege, and I was not.

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: Eventually, I looked to the Sect of Ranul for guidance. I thought they might have shown me my path, but I was wrong.

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: Before long, I was their leader and it was instead me who was being looked to for guidance, for purpose. In truth though, even then I had nothing I could offer. I was as blind as I had always been.

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: But the day came when I finally saw my purpose, for I was blessed with a vision, granted to me by Ralos and Ranul themselves! I will share now with you what they shared with me.

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: Thirty one years ago, the moon eclipsed the sun and a false night fell across the land. That day marked a beginning, for it saw the birth of a pair of twins.

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: To most, they were children like any other, but I was shown the truth of their birth, for as the sun and moon combined, Ralos and Ranul were born in mortal forms!

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: Now, they seek Mokhaiotl. There, they will unite us all as one, and a new world will be born. My purpose, which I now share with you, is to lead them there.

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: Blasphemy! Deceit! That is what people cry when they hear the truth. The Church of Ralos teaches that our work is false, and our royal leaders lap up their every word!

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: Perhaps you still harbour doubts yourselves. I do not judge you. We have all been lied to our entire lives, and in truth, even after I was blessed by our gods, I held many doubts myself.

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: But you have all been chosen. You have all achieved ascension. I know that you are among the few who will understand. You are among the few who can see the truth!

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: And see it you will! You do not need to take the word of a mere herald. Instead, bask in the glory of our gods reborn!
Ennius and Furia Tullus walk onto the stage. The new Emissaries, including the player and Prince Itzla, kneel.

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: You may recognise these faces as Ennius and Furia Tullus, but now I give you the truth. Before you stand our gods! Ralos and Ranul!

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: Together, we will accompany them on their glorious journey! We will guide them to Mokhaiotl and bring about the Final Dawn! This is our purpose! This is our destiny! This is Twilight's Promise!

initiation.speaker: Augur Metzli
initiation.text: You all have a part to play in what is to come. Forebearer Fides will assign you your duties. Speak with her and then go forth. Go forth and serve our gods!

initiation-talking-to-fides-before-itzla.speaker: Forebearer Fides
initiation-talking-to-fides-before-itzla.text: Welcome, acolyte, and congratulations on your initiation. I am just making the final preparations on the duties for you and your companion. They will be ready shortly.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.text: Well that was a level of insanity that even I wasn't ready for.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.player: They think Ennius and Furia are Ralos and Ranul reborn...

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.text: Like I say, complete insanity! Metzli has twisted the minds of everyone here. They eagerly lap up her outlandish claims without ever stopping to consider how ludicrous they are.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.text: In some ways, I pity them, but alas, there is only one cure for this sort of thing. This cult must be eradicated, especially Metzli, Furia and Ennius.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.player: I'm still confused over what their plan is... They want to reach Mokhaiotl, but why would they need to kill Servius to do that? And why the whole set up with that Knight of Varlamore?
When Furia and Ennius set that knight up, it was so obvious. It's like they wanted us to know it was them.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.text: Hmm... A very good point. Could be this cult has just addled their brains, but it may be that they wanted us here.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.text: I guess we will find out soon enough.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.player: Should we not leave? We know the cult is guilty now, and we know Metzli, Furia and Ennius are part of it. We have everything we need.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.text: You said yourself, there are questions still unanswered. We must rectify that.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.player: So if there is a trap, you'd willingly spring it?

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.text: Well it would be the last thing they'd expect.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.text: Let's have a chat to this Forebearer Fides about our new duties. Whatever they are, hopefully they give us a chance to learn more.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-after.text: Let's see what duties this Forebearer Fides has for us.

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.speaker: Forebearer Fides
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.text: Welcome, acolytes. Congratulations on your initiation.

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.text: Thank you! We're absolutely ecstatic to be here and we're ready to serve!

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.speaker: Forebearer Fides
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.text: I am glad to see you are so eager. We have an essential task for you to help perform. The completion of this task may well be essential in us finding a route to Mokhaiotl.

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.player: What would you have us do?

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.speaker: Forebearer Fides
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.text: After the Augur was blessed with glorious purpose, she felt a calling to this place. She came to this fallen temple and built us a home. However, it was not the temple that called to her, but what lies below.

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.speaker: Forebearer Fides
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.text: This temple was built atop Tapoyauik, a ruined fortress of the Old Ones. They walked the world during the last cycle, and when the time came for their cycle to end, they embraced their destiny willingly.

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.speaker: Forebearer Fides
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.text: Of course! They basked in the glory of Ralos and Ranul and united with them as one, but before they did, they left behind the secrets needed to ensure that we too could fulfil our purpose.

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.text: And the Augur? She found those secrets below?

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.speaker: Forebearer Fides
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.text: She did, but there is more to be uncovered. That is where you come in. Tapoyauik is a hostile environment and the passage into the ruins has been blocked.

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.speaker: Forebearer Fides
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides.text: Head below and support the efforts in opening the path once more. Do this, and you will be rewarded by Ralos and Ranul themselves!

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides-t.speaker: Forebearer Fides
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides-t.text: Welcome back, acolytes. You should head below and support the efforts in opening the path into Tapoyauik. Do this, and you will be rewarded by Ralos and Ranul themselves!

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides-t.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides-t.text: Let's head down into these ruins.

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides-l.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides-l.text: I'll wait for you inside the temple, [player name].

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides-l.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides-l.text: Nilsal, [player name]. Let's head down into these ruins.

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: Yes?

steps.player: Can we go down there?

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: You may. Now move along.

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: Yes?

steps.player: Can I go down there?

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: You may, but you should fetch your companion first.

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides-t.speaker: Emissary Ascended
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-fides-t.text: Hey! You should go get your companion before going down there!

initiation-entering-tapoyauik.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-entering-tapoyauik.text: How are you with a pickaxe, iknami? I must confess, my own skills with one are rather poor.

initiation-entering-tapoyauik.player: Did they never teach you how to do a bit of hard labour back when you were young?

initiation-entering-tapoyauik.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-entering-tapoyauik.text: We all have different callings, my friend. Mining just wasn't mine.

initiation-entering-tapoyauik.player: Clearly combat wasn't either given that performance earlier.

initiation-entering-tapoyauik.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-entering-tapoyauik.text: Oh I see! You win one fight and you start thinking you're something special.

initiation-entering-tapoyauik.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-entering-tapoyauik.text: Well then a bit of mining shouldn't be any issue for you then. Get to it!

initiation-talking-to-forebearer-vulcan.speaker: Forebearer Vulcan
initiation-talking-to-forebearer-vulcan.text: That blockage won't clear itself! Grab a pickaxe and get to work!

initiation-after-clearing-the-rocks.speaker: Forebearer Vulcan
initiation-after-clearing-the-rocks.text: Excellent work! Ralos and Ranul have blessed us on this day!
The screen stops shaking as two frost nagua appear.
The two acolytes run away. The nagua both cast spells, killing Forebearer Vulcan and knocking Prince Itzla back across a chasm.

initiation-after-clearing-the-rocks.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-after-clearing-the-rocks.text: Well... I'm alive, which I must be honest, I wasn't really expecting after that!

initiation-after-clearing-the-rocks.player: I can't see any way over to you.

initiation-after-clearing-the-rocks.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-after-clearing-the-rocks.text: Nor can I. I think we're just going to have to press on and hope that we can meet up again further ahead.

initiation-after-clearing-the-rocks.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-after-clearing-the-rocks.text: Do you see any other options?

initiation-after-clearing-the-rocks.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-after-clearing-the-rocks.text: Than I shall meet you up ahead. Good luck!

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-by-th.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-by-th.text: There you are! I was starting to worry you'd got lost.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-by-th.player: There were a few obstacles in my way.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-by-th.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-by-th.text: Well unfortunately it seems we have another before us. I can't see any way to open this door.

initiation-talking-to-prince-itzla-by-th.player: Hmm... I'll have a look around and see what I can find.

options.text: Could I ask you about some words I found carved into the wall?

steps.player: Could I ask you about some words I found carved into the wall?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'll do my best.

steps.player: Oma.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Oma? If I remember right, that means the number 'two'.

steps.player: Thanks!
Yeya.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Yeya? That means...

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I think it means 'three'.

steps.player: Thanks!
Naui.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Naui? Hmm...

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'm afraid I don't know what that one means.

steps.player: Not to worry. I'm sure I can still work it out.
Zema.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Zema? Let's see... That could mean a few things. 'Together', 'people' and 'one' are the ones I remember.

steps.player: Interesting... Thanks!

options.text: What do you think Metzli found down here?

steps.player: What do you think Metzli found down here?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Nothing is my guess. The whole point of Ximoua is that it can't be, and shouldn't be, predicted. It's meant to teach us to live freely and not worry about that which we can't control.

steps.player: So she's lying?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: That, or she herself was so desperate to find a greater meaning in something, that she misinterpreted what she did find.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I suppose it doesn't matter though. This Final Dawn business is total nonsense, but if the Emissaries believe in it, then we need to work out what they consider so important about this place.

options.text: Could I ask you about some words I found carved into the wall?
On that note, I guess I should get back to the door.

steps.player: On that note, I guess I should get back to the door.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Indeed. There must be some way to open it...

steps.player: Nothing yet.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: There must be some way to open it...

initiation-if-prince-itzla-targets-an-ic.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-if-prince-itzla-targets-an-ic.text: Help me kill this thing, would you?

initiation-solving-the-puzzle-checking-t.text: The door seems to be frozen shut. There must be some way to open it.

initiation-solving-the-puzzle-interactin.text: The statue has [a water/a fire/an earth] symbol at the base. It looks like it's meant to be holding something.

steps.prompt: Place an icon on the statue?

steps.text: Water statue:
You place the icon on the statue.
Earth statue:
You place the icon on the statue.
Fire statue:
You place the icon on the statue.

initiation-solving-the-puzzle-interactin.text: If not holding the corresponding icon:
The statue has [an air/a water/a fire/an earth] symbol at the base. It's holding some sort of icon.

initiation-after-opening-the-door.text: The room shakes as the statues unleash their power on the locked door.

initiation-after-opening-the-door.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
initiation-after-opening-the-door.text: Great work opening the door, [player name]. Time to see what awaits us on the other side.

heart-of-the-ruins.text: Amoxliatl, a large ice nagua, appears.

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Amoxliatl
heart-of-the-ruins.text: Humans... You stand before Amoxliatl. State your intent.

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Amoxliatl
heart-of-the-ruins.text: A greeting is not a statement of intent. State your intent.

heart-of-the-ruins.player: Er... Well we're looking for information. The cultists in the temple above apparently found something down here. We need to know what they found so we can stop them.

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Amoxliatl
heart-of-the-ruins.text: Your statement lacks specificity. Clarify. What information?

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
heart-of-the-ruins.text: On Mokhaiotl. The cultists are trying to get there.

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Amoxliatl
heart-of-the-ruins.text: Mokhaiotl? The Tlati archive? That place is not for your kind. You misused the gifts you were granted. You are unworthy.

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
heart-of-the-ruins.text: Tlati? As in the rainforest? What do you mean? And what gifts?
Prince Itzla is teleported away. Metzli, Furia, Ennius, and two Emissaries enter the room.

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Augur Metzli
heart-of-the-ruins.text: Itzla? He is no longer your concern.

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Ennius Tullus
heart-of-the-ruins.text: Allow me to deal with this nuisance, Augur. The fire of Ralos is within me. He can be the first to bask in it.

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Furia Tullus
heart-of-the-ruins.text: Save your fury, brother. This one is unworthy of it.

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Amoxliatl
heart-of-the-ruins.text: Human arrogance. Here in Tapoyauik, I decide who is worthy.

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Ennius Tullus
heart-of-the-ruins.text: Silence, nagua! Do you not know who stands before you?

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Amoxliatl
heart-of-the-ruins.text: You? You are nothing. You defile this place. Now face the consequences.

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Augur Metzli
heart-of-the-ruins.text: There is nothing more for us here. If the nagua wants blood, our friend here will provide plenty...

heart-of-the-ruins.player: I need to get after them!

heart-of-the-ruins.speaker: Amoxliatl
heart-of-the-ruins.text: After them? No. You will not be going anywhere...

heart-of-the-ruins-after-defeating-amoxl.player: I'd better get to Fortis and let them know what happened!

heart-of-the-ruins-attempting-to-re-ente.player: I need to get over to Fortis rather than going in there again.

heart-of-the-ruins-attempting-to-climb-t.text: You've already completed the trials so have no need to go back up there.

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.text: Ah, nilsal, my child. It is good to see you.

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.player: Servius? I wasn't expecting you to be up so soon.

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.text: Ralos still has need of me, my child. I will not bow down to a mere knife wound.

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.player: Well I'm glad to see you're doing well, but I'm afraid I have some bad news. Itzla has been captured!
We infiltrated the Twilight Emissaries together. We discovered Metzli to be their new leader, with Ennius and Furia at her side. She's claiming the two of them are Ralos and Ranul reborn!

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.text: Blasphemy and betrayal in equal measure! They will all burn in the light of Ralos for this! And you say they have captured the Prince as well?

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.player: They have. I don't know where they've taken him.

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.text: This is dire news. I must speak to the Queen at once. Is there anything else I should be aware of before doing so?

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.player: The cult are apparently trying to reach Mokhaiotl.

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.text: Mokhaiotl is not a place that can be reached! These fools are truly lost!
If Perilous Moons has not been completed:

steps.player: I don't know... Something isn't right about all of this. We encountered a creature in some Old One ruins. The cultists called her a nagua. She referred to Mokhaiotl as the Tlati archive.

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.text: If Perilous Moons has been completed:

steps.player: I don't know... Something isn't right about all of this. We encountered a nagua in some Old One ruins. She called Mokhaiotl the Tlati archive.

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.text: You should be careful of trusting the words of a nagua. Still, I must seek the guidance of Ralos on this matter. First though, I will speak with the Queen.

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.text: Fear not. I will ensure the Queen involves you in whatever plans are made for dealing with this cult. On that note, I'd best not delay. May the sun light your way, my child.

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.player: If you're going to speak to the Queen now, maybe I should join you?

heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
heart-of-the-ruins-talking-to-servius-te.text: Are you sure? It might be best for me to speak to her first. She will not take kindly to this development. I would hate for you to face her fire, my child.

t8gLJV.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
t8gLJV.text: But it seems we will have to ponder this mystery later. Pick up your follower and then let us head inside and see what tests await us.

uDj1Kv.speaker: Forebearer Janus
uDj1Kv.text: Then come back to me when you are.

s_fle1.speaker: Forebearer Janus
s_fle1.text: Recruit. Any luck finding the traitor yet?

s_fle1.speaker: Forebearer Janus
s_fle1.text: Remember, only one of the four before you is guilty of disloyalty. Question all four and determine who it is. I suggest you choose carefully.
